title: Footer calculation menu is offered on read-only package views; the list-view rows lose _packageId so the UI cannot tell them apart
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Found while building #35702 (PR #35919). Part of epic #35547 (list page redo).

## What a user sees
On a view that ships inside a read-only package, an admin is offered the footer calculation menu; picking a value is refused by the server (403, "save to the custom package"), the pick rolls back and a toast explains it. It works, but the admin is offered something that cannot succeed.

## Why
A dotted view name does not mean read-only: the console's own saved shared views are dotted too (e.g. `showcase_product.team_products`, stored in the custom package). The reliable signal is the view's package, but the data adapter's `listViews` drops `_packageId` from the rows, so the UI cannot see it.

## To do
Carry `_packageId` (or an explicit read-only flag) on list-view rows through the adapter, and offer the calculation menu (and any other view-saving entry, such as view settings save) only on views the admin can save.

## Acceptance
- A package-shipped read-only view shows no calculation menu; a custom shared view and a personal view still do.

Reader: `domain:ui` (data adapter + list view). Blocked by #35919 merging.
